findings.claim: With fractional-share positions the ticket can fall short of the cash needed while exiting 0: the sub-share remainder counts as sellable but is never sold or redistributed.
findings.evidence: kuroshio/core/book.py render_reduction_md: sellable sums full market_value, each sale is min(ceil(q*frac), floor(q)); rows with n<=0 are skipped. AAA 100sh/10000 + SLC 0.9sh/9000, cash 0, withdraw 5000 -> AAA 27, total 2,700 vs 5,000, exit 0.
findings.repro: PYTHONPATH=. python -c "from kuroshio.core.book import render_reduction_md as r; print(r([{'symbol':'AAA','quantity':100.0,'market_value':10000.0,'asset_type':'EQUITY'},{'symbol':'SLC','quantity':0.9,'market_value':9000.0,'asset_type':'EQUITY'}],{},5000,0))"
findings.acceptance: Ticket proceeds + cash >= withdraw with each name within one share of pro-rata, or a non-zero exit when whole-share sales cannot cover it; sellable total counts whole shares only; a fractional-quantity test pins it.

verifications.evidence: sellable counts whole shares only; original repro totals 5,000 vs 5,000; 10.5sh+3.7sh mix within one share per name; 10.5sh+0.6sh withdraw 1300 raises the sellable error; 520 passed
